images.mountains_birds_dawn: Majestic green mountains at sunrise with many small birds flying in a gentle circle above them, golden light, peaceful and joyful, nobody present.
images.army_far_dust: Far away on a wide plain, a huge cloud of dust and many tiny tents of a big army camp on the horizon, seen from a hill, tense but not scary, no people visible.
images.river_test: A clear cool river flowing through a dry desert valley in bright sunlight, sparkling water, a single cupped clay bowl on a rock by the shore, nobody present.
images.small_camp_hill: A small group of simple tents on a hill at dusk with a few campfires, stars appearing, brave and hopeful atmosphere.
images.sling_stones_sunrise: A simple leather shepherd's sling and three smooth river stones lying on a flat rock at sunrise, golden light, courage and calm.
images.zabur_scroll_light: An ancient scroll book resting on a wooden stand in soft golden light, gentle sparkles in the air, no readable letters, holy and calm.
images.iron_rings_glow: Glowing soft iron rings being linked into a fine chainmail on a wooden workbench, warm forge light, no hands, no people, craftsmanship.
images.chainmail_workshop: A tidy ancient workshop with finished chainmail shirts hanging neatly on wooden pegs, tools on the bench, warm afternoon light, nobody present.
images.moon_half_night: A calm night with a half moon over a quiet hilltop with a simple prayer rug, peaceful, prayerful atmosphere.
